name: December
summary: Holiday weeks carry the month: the warm parks run their busiest stretch of the winter while the northern parks run their rare, decorated weekend calendars — with real cold as the price.

verdict.short: December at these parks: a good window with known trade-offs. Holiday weeks carry the month: the warm parks run their busiest stretch of the winter while the northern parks run their rare, decorated weekend calendars.

crowds.shape: Holiday weeks carry the month: the warm parks run their busiest stretch of the winter while the northern parks run their rare, decorated weekend calendars — with real cold as the price.

cost.note: Ticket prices move by date at every park on this site; the level describes the month's overall shape rather than any single day.

planningNotes.heading: The month in one decision
body: The Christmas-to-New Year week is the winter's peak everywhere on this site — the same crowd math as July Fourth with colder weather at the northern parks.

planningNotes.heading: The detail that matters
body: The first two December weeks are a quiet, decorated secret at the warm parks: full holiday programming at shoulder crowds.

freshness.sourceNote: Crowd and cost shapes describe multi-year patterns across the ten parks rather than a forecast for any single year. Weather figures are climate normals for each region and do not decay; the Texas figures blend the DFW and San Antonio areas, and the Southern California figures blend the coastal and inland valleys.
